about.title: About Fresh Start
about.description: Fresh Start is a preparation platform for bankruptcy consultations. It organizes financial information, identifies gaps, and prepares questions for professional review. It is not a law firm, does not provide legal advice, does not choose a chapter as a legal conclusion, does not determine eligibility, and does not file petitions.

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.content: This is a demo environment: all names, cases, and numbers are fictional. Case state is stored locally in your browser; the backend processes each request without storing the case between requests.

security.title: Security
security.content: Access uses short-lived JWTs and separate client/attorney roles. Before using real data, demo credentials and signing secrets must be replaced with production values — see

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.content: The interface uses Flowbite components (with built-in focus handling and keyboard navigation), labels linked to each field, and WCAG AA contrast for text and controls.

terms.title: Terms
terms.content: Using this demo does not create an attorney-client relationship. Information generated by the assistant always requires review and confirmation by a licensed attorney before any decision is made.

help.title: Help
